svg.title: Quick start in four commands
svg.desc: A terminal session. Prepare pins each model to a commit and marks rows ready or held without using a GPU. Launch measures GPU spectra and CPU fingerprints and publishes one package per model. zoo.cli build writes Parquet tables and a retrieval index. zoo_keeper.cli similar finds the nearest models by weight fingerprint, offline.

g.text: pins every row to a commit · ready rows launch, held rows keep a reason · no GPU
GPU spectra and CPU fingerprints · one immutable package per model
Parquet tables and a retrieval index in $ZOO_DATA/builds/current
nearest models by weight fingerprint · no weights or GPU needed
